cues.en: There are three laws of test driven development. The first one everybody knows, you are not allowed to write a line of production code until you have written a failing unit test.
cues.zh: 测试驱动开发有三条法则。第一条大家都知道：在没有写出一个失败的单元测试之前，你不许写任何一行生产代码。

cues.en: This is called test first, and it is the rule that everybody kind of sniffs at and goes, well, does it really matter? I can write my test after I write my code. But follow me for a moment.
cues.zh: 这叫做测试优先，是一条人人都有点不屑一顾的规则：“这真重要吗？我完全可以先写代码再补测试嘛。”但请听我说下去。

cues.en: You are not allowed to write a line of production code until you have written a failing unit test.
cues.zh: 在没有写出一个失败的单元测试之前，你不许写任何一行生产代码。

cues.en: The second law
cues.zh: 第二条法则

cues.en: is that you are not allowed to write more of a unit test than is sufficient to fail. You cannot write the whole unit test.

cues.en: As soon as that unit test fails, you must stop writing it. Now, that you have a little runner, and this little runner constantly runs your unit test. It's stuck in a hard loop. It never ever stops. It's just always running your unit tests. And as you are typing production code,
cues.zh: 测试一失败，就必须停下来写。这时候你有一个小小的运行器，这个小运行器不停地跑你的单元测试。它卡在一个死循环里，永远不停，一直跑着你的单元测试。当你敲生产代码的时候，
